verificationScope: static repository and export-contract validation; no live browser or device render was performed

evidence: Each file exists in the web runtime asset tree.
Each file has a valid GLB header, glTF 2.0 asset version, mesh payload, material payload, and named gameplay attachment nodes.
These are current v1 runtime exports, not the pending high-resolution source packages.
The existing 3D asset audit reports the procedural weapon, obstacle, supply, chest, enemy, and tactical families as present.
These factories are runtime presentation contracts and do not substitute for upstream source meshes, cinematic textures, rigs, or mocap.
The page exposes local character, enemy, weapon, environment, supply, tactical, and chest inspection families.
The script uses the bundled Three.js and GLTFLoader paths and contains no remote renderer dependency.
Authored GLB loading and procedural fallback are both represented in the inspection surface.
The existing report has zero missing runtime assets and marks the render lab ready.
Its ready counts are treated as supporting evidence for the runtime export boundary only.

pendingSourceArt.evidence: The AAA manifest defines the 8-20 million triangle sculpt and retopology targets, but no authored source package is present under the candidate roots.
pendingSourceArt.runtimeProxyDoesNotCount: The six v1 GLBs are runtime blockout/reference exports and do not prove high-resolution sculpt or retopology delivery.

pendingSourceArt.evidence: The AAA manifest requires a dialogue-ready facial rig and blendshape set, but no authored facial-rig package is present under the candidate roots.
pendingSourceArt.runtimeProxyDoesNotCount: Named attachment nodes and procedural poses do not prove a deforming facial rig or dialogue-ready expressions.

pendingSourceArt.evidence: The AAA manifest defines hero 4096px PBR targets and cinematic material requirements, but no authored cinematic texture package is present under the candidate roots.
pendingSourceArt.runtimeProxyDoesNotCount: Runtime PNG renders and concept/reference images are not a cinematic PBR texture set.

pendingSourceArt.evidence: The AAA manifest lists the motion-capture retarget library and required combat, locomotion, revive, and dialogue clips, but no authored mocap clip package is present under the candidate roots.
pendingSourceArt.runtimeProxyDoesNotCount: Procedural pose controllers and static GLB exports do not prove mocap clip delivery or retarget validation.

releaseDecision.statement: Runtime exports and the local inspection surface are verified by static evidence. The upstream source-art production package is not complete and must not be marked complete from these runtime proxies.
